sections.titre: Reduce the environmental impact of the event

haut.chapo: For more than 40 years, the Route du Rhum - Destination Guadeloupe has sparked dreams, brought people together, and inspired. In the face of the climate, societal, and economic challenges of our time, OC Sport Pen Duick reaffirms a strong commitment: to make the race a more sustainable, more inclusive event, more deeply rooted in the communities that support it. Our CSR approach is based on a clear conviction: a major event can be demanding, spectacular, and mindful of its impact all at once.

photo.alt: The fleet out at sea after the start, backlit on a silvery sea

manifeste.lead: What the ocean connects are the lands that give it life. Our race is not just a race. It is a commitment between two worlds that echo one another:
strophe: Saint-Malo and Guadeloupe. Granite and volcano.
The start and the finish. Momentum and welcome.
The ocean unites. But it is together that land and sea tell their story.

promesses.phrase: To the ocean, we promise to protect.
promesses.suite: To lighten our footprint and respect its precious balance.

promesses.phrase: To the communities, we promise to bring people together.
promesses.suite: Those who, far from the open sea, keep the spirit of the race alive through their voices, their expertise, and their actions.

promesses.phrase: To future generations, we promise to pass on a living, sustainable, and accessible heritage.
promesses.suite: And the idea that setting out is not enough if there is nothing left to share.

manifeste.chute: Our “Terres d’Engagements” are not a distant destination, but a journey to be shared every day.

pactes.titre: Reduce the environmental impact of the event
pactes.description: This initial commitment doesn't aim for perfection: it charts a concrete and measurable course, to continue inspiring dreams while easing the burden where possible. Better-designed routes, more circular villages, greater respect for our environment—every action counts.
pactes.questionRhetorique: What if taking care of the road was already a way of honoring the destination?

Rail partnership with SNCF and the Brittany Region — SNCF → https://www.routedurhum.com/nos-partenaires/sncf-groupe / Brittany Region → https://www.routedurhum.com/nos-partenaires/région-bretagne
Dedicated communication campaign to encourage train travel, active mobility, and the BreizhGo public transport system.

Bicycle parking facilities at the village entrances.
Carpooling option offered to visitors, in addition to low-carbon transport.
Fleet of official vehicles: 100% electric. — Suzuki → https://www.routedurhum.com/nos-partenaires/suzuki

sousThemes.initiatives:
A 100% electric village, free from fossil fuels. — City of Saint-Malo → https://www.routedurhum.com/nos-partenaires/ville-de-saint-malo / EDF → https://www.routedurhum.com/nos-partenaires/edf
Waste sorting adapted to each area of the village. — City and Greater Saint-Malo Area → https://www.routedurhum.com/nos-partenaires/ville-de-saint-malo / CITEO → https://www.routedurhum.com/nos-partenaires/citeo
Dedicated collection of food waste at food outlets. — La Petite Boucle (Social and Solidarity Economy)
Charter for restaurants and bars: vegetarian options, local and seasonal products, waste reduction.

Zero cargo return: boats now sail back, a rule included in the Notice of Race.
Hazard Reporting System: real-time reporting by skippers of marine animals or floating objects. — Adrena → https://www.routedurhum.com/nos-partenaires/adrena
Cetacean protection zones, scientifically defined to reduce the risk of collisions. — MMAG / Share the Ocean
Natura 2000 commitment to preserve coastal natural areas, from Pointe du Grouin to Cap Fréhel. — DDTM / Conservatoire du Littoral / Departments of Ille-et-Vilaine and Côtes d'Armor / Prefectures / Brittany Region → https://www.routedurhum.com/nos-partenaires/région-bretagne / Rance Emeraude Regional Natural Park

pactes.description: It is on land that the race takes root, fueled by the energy of those who bring it to life: businesses, associations, residents, local authorities, and fans. From Saint-Malo to Pointe-à-Pitre, it is experienced together, with a constant focus on openness, sharing, and lasting impact.
pactes.questionRhetorique: What if the race brought people together far beyond the finish line?

image.alt: The crowd gathered on the tip of Cap Fréhel, at the foot of the lighthouse

sousThemes.initiatives: Local associations are welcomed free of charge to the race village through an annual call for projects. Activities are held throughout the Saint-Malo area: the race village, the city center, the Bourse maritime station, and neighboring towns.

100% of the public village is accessible to people with disabilities.
Sign language interpretation of key moments during the event.
One hour (12:30 PM - 1:30 PM) per day without music to provide respite for those with sensitivities.
A dedicated quiet zone within the village, away from the noise.
Accessible parking is located in the immediate vicinity of the village, and cable management systems are available throughout the site.

Support for the local economy: local businesses, service providers, and companies mobilized for the event.
Recognition of the commitment of volunteers and the services that make the race possible.
Generation of local jobs, both direct and indirect, related to the organization of the event.

pactes.description: Its heritage is born in the emotions of yesterday and is lived in the evolution of today's sailboats: it rests on years of stories, gestures and shared memories that we must perpetuate.
pactes.questionRhetorique: What if extending the spirit of the race was already setting a course for the future?

image.alt: A Vintage Multi trimaran under sail, out at sea

sousThemes.initiatives: A place to live and celebrate the Route du Rhum in Saint-Malo, extending the spirit of the race throughout the year. A living link with Guadeloupean maritime culture, between Saint-Malo and Pointe-à-Pitre.

The Vintage Mono & Multi categories celebrate boats that have made their mark on the history of the race.
Sustainability criteria are integrated into the selection of boats in these categories.

A project for a permanent Route du Rhum exhibit at the Hydro Maritime Museum in Saint-Malo.
